pack.name: AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower
pack.description: Organizations, Control Tower, SCP guardrails, and hub-spoke networking themes. Thematic mapping only; not Control Tower conformance certification.

rules.title: AWS Organizations OU hierarchy documented
rules.description: Platform scope should describe how member accounts roll up through organizational units (security, infrastructure, workloads) so SCP inheritance and access boundaries are reviewable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document OU hierarchy intent in governance.PolicyConstraints; cite organization and account scope from awsExtractor.manifest when inventory is present.

rules.title: Account vending and workload placement explained
rules.description: Each workload account should have a documented purpose, environment class, and owning team when Control Tower or Organizations account vending is in scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Mirror account purpose in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.ComplianceTags; align services[].Tags with environment and cost-center keys.

rules.title: Hub-spoke or Transit Gateway topology described
rules.description: Connectivity between hub and spoke VPCs (or Transit Gateway attachments) must be understandable from architecture relationships and governance narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Model hub/spoke edges in relationships with AuthenticatesWith/ReadsFrom semantics where applicable; document TGW attachments or VPC peering in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: SCP and AWS Config conformance alignment stated
rules.description: When AWS Config compliance exports or governance metadata reference SCP guardrails or conformance packs, non-compliance themes should be dispositioned or risk-accepted with traceable narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Summarize SCP and Config gaps in governance.PolicyConstraints; tie account scope to reviewer sign-off in metadata.DecisionTraceIds.

rules.title: Platform identity baseline (IAM Identity Center) documented
rules.description: Landing-zone identity posture should describe privileged access, break-glass, and workload identity patterns (IRSA and instance profiles over long-lived access keys).
rules.remediationGuidance: Encode identity commitments in governance.RequiredControls; tag platform services with identity:* keys on services[].Tags.

frameworkMappings.designArea: Identity — IAM Identity Center and RBAC

rules.title: Centralized logging and monitoring landing zone
rules.description: CloudTrail, Config, and workload logs from platform and member accounts should converge to a documented security/audit account or centralized CloudWatch/S3 sink.
rules.remediationGuidance: Declare observability sink ownership in governance.PolicyConstraints; reference awsExtractor.manifest.CollectionTimestamp when audit exports accompany the package.

rules.title: Route 53 private zones and VPC endpoints
rules.description: Private hosted zones and interface VPC endpoints for AWS services should be documented when landing-zone standards require private connectivity.
rules.remediationGuidance: Set PrivateEndpointRequired on sensitive datastores[]; document Route 53 and endpoint linkage in relationships and governance.PolicyConstraints.

frameworkMappings.designArea: Networking — Private DNS and VPC endpoints

rules.title: Security Hub and GuardDuty posture referenced
rules.description: Platform security baseline should mention Security Hub standards and GuardDuty coverage when regulated workloads are in scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture security-hub and guardduty commitments in governance.ComplianceTags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Mandatory resource tagging for FinOps allocation
rules.description: Landing-zone tagging standards (environment, cost center, owner) should be visible on manifest services and reflected in AWS inventory when exported.
rules.remediationGuidance: Audit services[].Tags and governance.ComplianceTags against mandatory tag policy; correlate with awsExtractor inventory tag columns when available.

rules.title: Segregation of duties for platform operations
rules.description: Platform team roles (network, security, identity, workload) should show separation in governance metadata when SOX or regulated controls apply.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document RACI or SoD statements in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Shared services account boundaries
rules.description: Shared services (network firewall, Route 53 resolver, bastion, ECR) should declare which account hosts them and how spoke workloads consume them.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe shared-service placement in governance.PolicyConstraints; link consuming workloads via relationships.

rules.title: Evidence freshness for landing-zone reviews
rules.description: Reviews citing AWS inventory must record collection timestamp and extractor switches so landing-zone drift is auditable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Cite awsExtractor.manifest.CollectionTimestamp, SchemaVersion, and SwitchesUsed in metadata.ChangeDescription.
